rows: Start with the sequence, not the claim. Which move comes first in your plan?
The brawling is a means, not an end. What does it set up?
A risk changes the sequence. Tell me what the sequence looks like when it fails.
Pace is a variable. I will choose it, not you.
The people are watching a sequence that repeats. I can give them a new one.
Cause, then effect. That is the whole of my argument.
I have worked the cause and effect across the circuit, and the result is clear.
The stance is the start of a sequence. Watch what comes after it.
Technique, then the next step. Describe the first observable step of your best hold.
Strikes produce a reaction. The question is what the reaction produces next.
Risk without a sequence is a guess. Show me the sequence.
A stall is a gap in the sequence. I will not leave you a gap.
The people deserve cause and effect, not noise. Give them a result they can follow.
You say you are among the best. Show the sequence. What is the observable evidence for that?
You are proud of your {strength}. Sequence is what makes it useful. Sequence is what makes it useful, and I want to see it.
I have traced your {strength} through the match, and I see where it breaks down.
Cool head, that is the first step. Okay. It keeps the sequence clean.
That lands in the sequence. The first point is agreed, so let us move to the second.
I could raise the stakes. I would rather show the cause and effect.
One count, in its place. Clear conditions, clear outcome. I will show you the sequence.
On the mat, every position leads to the next. Stay with me through the sequence.
Grounded or standing, the sequence still starts with the first grip.
Stay here, face me, next in sequence. I want to see your next step.
A sound answer. It follows from what you said, which is rare.
You have not answered the question. It is a simple one. Please answer it.
That lands in the sequence. I accept that as the first step.
That step I accept. It is a reasonable place to begin.
I will carry this sequence through to the finish, and I will not change it halfway.
My approach is methodical. I will finish what I start.
Whatever happens, the result will follow from what we did.
The result is not written. The sequence is still open.
I have one more step to show you. You will see it when the bell rings.
